notes.title: Huge performance fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We’re pleased to announce that The Lab - Escape Room has just received a significant update! 

We’ve implemented major performance fixes to ensure a smoother gameplay and a more seamless experience! And alongside these improvements, we’ve also addressed some minor bugs!

Jump back into The Lab and enjoy the enhanced adventure today! And feel free to give us some feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960930/The_Lab__Escape_Room/

notes.title: The Island - Escape Room demo is here!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We are happy to announce that the demo of our next game, The Island - Escape Room is here!

[i]You wake up on an unknown island, alone and without help. Will you be able to solve the mysteries it contains? Will you find out how you got there? Could you escape from The Island?[/i]

The Island is an Escape Room where you have to make your way through intelligence and lateral thinking. You will solve a huge number of puzzles while discovering an interesting story and moving through the corners of an island full of challenges. Search for clues, find objects and secrets and keep a cool head, because only then you will be able to get out alive from The Island!

You can play it now at the Steam Next Fest and please add it to your wishlist if you like it!

Thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819730/The_Island__Escape_Room/

notes.title: The Lab - Escape Room launches today!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We are happy to announce that you can get The Lab - Escape Room just right now!

Version 1.0 is here and we are sure that you are going to love it! With more than 40 puzzles and many rooms with different themes, you can solve the misteries of The Lab with a 10% discount!

Feel free to give us your feedback and enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960930/The_Lab__Escape_Room/
